title: TimeXL: Explainable Multi-Modal Time Series Prediction with LLM-in-the-Loop

claim.summary: TimeXL fuses prototype-based multimodal predictions with an LLM and iteratively refines textual context using training/validation feedback.

modules.name: Prototype explanation-conditioned predictive fusion
modules.scope_reason: Encoder and LLM outputs are fused for future discrete-label predictions.

modules.name: Reflection-driven context refinement
modules.scope_reason: Feedback uses prediction ground truth to refine text and retrain the predictor; the loop is prediction-specific.
